description: This file is a controller class for handling employee qualifications in the OrangeHRM system. It manages rendering views related to employee language qualifications, setting component properties, and permissions based on request data.

classes.name: EmployeeQualificationsController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing employee qualifications view and permissions in the HRM system. Extends BaseViewEmployeeController to leverage common employee view functionalities.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares view component with employee language data and permissions before rendering.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data group identifiers for capability permission checks related to employee qualifications.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the qualifications component with employee language fluencies and competencies, sets permissions, or handles bad requests if employee number is missing.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Provides a list of qualification-related permission groups needed for access control.
